EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: DS/GFG/LE//2012/01. Land Ministry reference No.: 4/3/6/2012/HW/313.
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Twenty Nine (29) allotments of land in total extent of about 0.5159 hectare, shown as lot No. 175-345 depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. 810022 dated 2015.02.11 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Dedugoda North in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of For Gravets, Galle in Galle District, Southern Province, morefully described below.
